description: This file defines the CloudTrailDataClient class, a client for interacting with the AWS CloudTrail Data Service, extending the AwsClient class and providing methods for putting audit events synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: CloudTrailDataClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS CloudTrail Data Service, extending standard AWS client functionality.

methods.name: putAuditEvents
methods.description: Method to synchronously put audit events into CloudTrail Data Service.

methods.name: putAuditEventsAsync
methods.description: Method to asynchronously put audit events into CloudTrail Data Service.
